phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F5 Phase B — Bilateral Component and Issuer-Applicability Audit
purpose: Test whether bilateral total F5 can be recovered from F51 equity plus F52 investment fund shares/units while distinguishing genuine missingness from the structural issuer scope of F52.

official_structural_basis.F52_definition: Investment fund shares or units are shares/units issued by investment funds, which are collective investment undertakings.
official_structural_basis.RMD_implication: Resident F52 issuance belongs inside the RMD financial sector F. Resident issuers H, C, G and BNR are structural non-issuers of F52; foreign investment-fund issuance remains inside X.
official_structural_basis.issuer_F_source_rule: For F52 liabilities issued by resident F, S12 may be used directly because S121 is structurally a non-issuer of F52; this is an instrument-specific issuer identity and does not generalize to F51 or other instruments.

promotion_rule: A bilateral F5 candidate exists only when F51 is resolved and F52 is either resolved or formally structural-zero because the resident issuer is H/C/G/BNR. This phase does not materialize; exact rank/nullity and immutable provenance are later gates.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; no feedback, delay, behavioural equation or closure status changes.
